summary.text: Matthew Dawson is a Democratic state representative who has represented Rhode Island House of Representatives District 65 since January 3, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is an attorney and former probate judge in East Providence.

paragraphs.text: Dawson lives in Riverside, Rhode Island, and graduated from East Providence High School in 1986.
He earned a B.A. in political science, government, and journalism from the University of Rhode Island in 1990 and a J.D. from the New England School of Law in 1995.
His career includes work as an attorney in private practice, as a prosecutor for the Rhode Island attorney general's office, and as a probate judge in East Providence.
